title: Mechatronics Engineer: Automated Chemistry Technology
text:
**About Us**
Telescope Innovations Corp. is a Vancouver-based, chemical technology company developing scalable manufacturing processes and tools for the pharmaceutical and chemical industry. The Company builds and deploys new enabling technologies including flexible robotic platforms and artificial intelligence software that improves experimental throughput, efficiency, and data quality. We focus on process innovation, particularly for the production of medicinal compounds and battery materials. Our aim is to bring modern chemical technology solutions to meet the most serious challenges in health and sustainability.
Visit us at telescopeinnovations.com
**Reporting structure and time-commitment**
- Reports to Chief Technology Officer
- Full time
- Indefinite term
- In-person role at [phone removed] East Mall
**Job duties**
- Automation technology development
- Design, develop, prototype, and optimize new automation technologies and systems for chemistry workflows within self-driving labs
- Optimize robustness and flexibility of custom or commercially available hardware and software modules, including but not limited to:
- automated chemical synthesis modules (Mettler Toledo EasyMax, UnchainedLabs Junior, Chemspeed SWING, Amigo Chem, or custom modules withprogrammable heat/stir elements, etc.),
- Analysis modules (HPLC, DirectInject-LC, FTIR, EasyViewer, or custommodules)
- Sample translocation (cartesian robots, articulated robotic arms, gantrysystems)
- Collaborate with chemists and process engineers to integrate automation solutions into experimental workflows
- Create and implement experimental protocols for testing new automation technologies in chemical synthesis and analysis
- Systems integration and maintenance
- Oversee the integration of automation systems with existing laboratory equipment and processes.
- Troubleshoot, maintain, and upgrade automation platforms, including robotic systems, automated reactors, and high-performance analytical instruments.
- Technical communication
- Prepares research output presentations, including clear data visualizations of high-density data for both technical audiences and general public
- Integrates with computer science colleagues for the curation of large data sets and data visualization.
- Supports the development of technical grant proposals for submission to national and international granting agencies
- Supports the preparation of technical manuscripts for internal use or publication
- Lab safety
- Complies with and supports Telescope’s safety protocols including:
- procedures for the use and disposal of chemical materials
- Telescope’s Environmental Management Plan
- maintenance of Telescope’s safety records
- WHMIS, UBC, and other agencies, as required
**Required qualifications**
- Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline ( Mechatronics Engineering, Robotics, Automation Engineering, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, etc.)
- Master’s or doctoral degree in a relevant discipline
- 4 years of demonstrated work experience or a combination of educational and workexperience in designing, developing, and implementing automation technologies, preferably ina chemistry or laboratory setting
- Experienced with Python and interfacing with APIs and code debugging
- Comfortable working with and debugging electronics and lab equipment
- Experience with parametric CAD software like SolidWorks and Fusion 360.
- Comfortable using hand tools and power tools
- Demonstrated experience in designing and executed automated chemistry workflows,including self-driving laboratories
- Experience with various UPLC / HPLC instruments, Chromatography Data Systems, vendorsand applications
- Open and effective communication style, excellent public presentation skills, strong peopleskills, cross-organizational teamwork and the ability to interact with and influence thedirection of key opinion leaders in the industry
- Demonstrated ability to work within a cooperative team environment and focus on individual,time dependent projects with minimal direct supervision
- Analytical, assertiveness, creativity and effective problem-solving skills
- Solid Skills in Microsoft Office to include Word, Excel and PowerPoint
**Compensation structure and benefits**
- Salary range: CAD$ 85,000 - 120,000
- Contractor or Employee: Employee
- Eligibility for Telescope’s extended health benefits programs: Eligible
- Vacation: 15 days of vacation per calendar year, prorated for the first year based on hiringdate. 1 additional day each subsequent year of service, up to a maximum of 20 days.
Apply at [[email removed]](mailto:[email removed]) with a cover letter and your resume.

title: Product Manager
text:
Company Description Telescope Innovations Corp. is a Vancouver-based, chemical technology company developing scalable manufacturing processes, products, and services for the pharmaceutical and high value chemical industry. The Company builds and deploys new enabling technologies including flexible robotic platforms and artificial intelligence software that improves experimental throughput, efficiency, and data quality. These platforms can be leveraged to decrease chemical process development costs and timelines. Our aim is to bring modern chemical technology solutions to meet the most serious challenges in health and sustainability. 

 

Visit us at telescopeinnovations.com 

Role Summary 

The Product Manager owns the commercial success of the DirectInject-LC and adjacent product lines. The role is market-facing and business-focused: understanding customers and markets, defining what to build and why, leading new products through Telescope's New Product Development and Introduction (NPDI) process to a successful launch, and driving sales, growth and margin. The Product Manager works alongside the Product Specialist, who provides technical product expertise, testing, documentation and technical customer support.

Reporting structure and time-commitment 

Reports to SVP Sales and Marketing 
Full time 
Indefinite term 
In-person role at [phone removed] East Mall 

Job duties 

Market Research and Customer Insight 

Conduct ongoing market research and competitive analysis across pharmaceutical and fine and specialty chemical segments to identify customer needs, market trends and growth opportunities 
Define and maintain market segmentation by industry, application and account 
Gather voice-of-customer input from customers, distribution partners and sales teams, and translate it into clear market and product requirements 
Size target markets and build business cases to support product line growth and new product investment decisions 

Product Strategy and Roadmap 

Own the product line strategy and multi-year roadmap to grow the product line vertically and horizontally across target segments 
Define product positioning and value propositions for each target segment 
Prioritize new products, upgrades and features based on market opportunity, customer value and business return 

New Product Development and Introduction (NPDI) 

Lead new product opportunities from ideation through launch using Telescope's NPDI program, including stage-gate reviews and the standard product readiness checklist 
Define market and product requirements, target pricing and target cost, and own the business case for each new product 
Partner with R&D, Manufacturing and the Product Specialist, who leads technical validation, testing and transfer to manufacturing, to keep projects on time and aligned with market needs 
Plan and lead product launches, including go-to-market strategy, launch timing, and readiness of sales, service and distribution partners 
Track post-launch commercial performance against the business case and recommend corrective actions 

Marketing and Go-to-Market 

Work with Telescope Marketing Communications to develop and release marketing programs that build product awareness, generate leads and support opportunity development 
Work with distribution partner marketing teams to develop and execute high-value joint marketing activities that support business development 
Own product messaging, sales tools and commercial collateral 

Product Line Business Management 

Accountable for product line sales, growth and margin targets; agree unit and revenue targets with senior management 
Set clear, structured pricing and drive margin contribution through pricing actions and cost reduction initiatives 
Manage part numbers and the commercial product catalogue 
Manage the specials process for custom configurations to ensure sustainable quality, operational and profit objectives 
Develop the service business and support service execution with the Service/Support organization 
Use product line health and quality KPIs provided by the Product Specialist to inform business priorities and investment decisions 

Forecasting and Reporting 

Proactively maintain the unit and revenue forecast for the product line and work with Operations and Finance to ensure the supply chain supports projected demand 
Give the Telescope management team full transparency on the forecast, and report critical sales funnel KPIs on a bi-weekly basis 

Distribution and Partner Management 

Plan, develop and manage distribution channel performance with distribution partners 
Own the sales and service training programs for distribution partners and internal teams (in person and virtual), with technical content supported by the Product Specialist 
Define the support structure for distributors and end-user customers 
Work directly with distribution partners, technical application specialists and customers to meet or exceed sales and margin objectives 
Develop and maintain relationships with key vendors and partners, including distribution partners and chromatography companies 

 

Other duties may be assigned 

 

Required qualifications 

Bachelor's Degree in Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or a related field required; MBA or formal business training an asset 
5+ years of product management experience with analytical instrumentation, laboratory automation, or related scientific products for the pharmaceutical, fine or specialty chemical industries 
Proven track record of leading new products through a structured development process from concept to commercial launch 
Demonstrated experience in market research, competitive analysis, market sizing and building business cases 
Experience with pricing strategy, sales forecasting and product line margin management 
Experience working with distribution partners and channel sales organizations 
Working knowledge of UPLC/HPLC, chromatography or Process Analytical Technologies (PAT) is an asset 
Open and effective communication style, excellent public presentation skills, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams, partners and key opinion leaders in the industry 
Strategic, data-driven thinker with strong commercial and financial acumen 
Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects with minimal direct supervision 
Excellent organizational skills 
Solid skills in Microsoft Office to include Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint; experience with CRM systems an asset 

 

Travel Requirements 

Willingness and ability to travel worldwide. Up to 30% travel is anticipated. 

 

Lab safety 

Complies with and supports Telescope Innovations' safety protocols including: 
Procedures for the use and disposal of chemical materials 
Telescope's Environmental Management Plan 
Maintenance of safety records 
WHMIS, UBC, and other agencies, as required 

 

Compensation structure and benefits 

Salary: CAD 115,000 to CAD 140,000 
Bonus: 20% of total compensation, based on company objectives and personal objectives mutually agreed upon with management 
Contractor or Employee: Employee 
Eligibility for Telescope's extended health benefits programs: Eligible 
Vacation: 15 days of vacation per calendar year, prorated for the first year based on hiring date. 1 additional day each subsequent year of service, up to a maximum of 20 days.
